caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular textile pattern featuring a dense, symmetrical arrangement of various flowers and leaves. The central focus is a large bouquet containing detailed roses and other assorted flowers, rendered in shades of red, pink, and yellow, with green leaves. Blue accents are present on several flowers and leaves, as well as in small scattered floral elements around the composition. Surrounding this central bouquet is an oval-shaped wreath made of similar flowers and greenery, interwoven with stems and foliage. The background alternates between a dark reddish-brown color and a light beige or off-white, creating a distinct contrast that highlights the floral designs. The entire image is bordered by a thick band of repeating floral elements and foliage, following the rectangular shape of the composition.
title: Printed Textile
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
